verdict.note: Real lint/add/remark run, each axis provoked alone: governed-code commit -> 'code changed'; description re-wrap (same words) -> fresh; one word changed -> 'scenario changed'; tags+test edit -> fresh; code narrowed to a path#symbol selector -> fresh; sibling scenario added -> only the sibling is eval-missing; unresolved remark -> 'remark changed'. Three axes, three distinct names, none moved by another's edit.
